about_the_game:
WELCOME BACK TO SCHOOL

35 of your classmates were murdered. Law enforcement's response was to cover everything up. Not a single living soul could tell you the whole story, so you decide to find out for yourself.

Take on the role of Amanda, an aspiring podcaster who yearns for a good story- something to really get some people tuning in. You break into your own high school to investigate, finding the truth behind the murders and uncovering that the truth is far more sinister than you could've ever imagined.

Be aware at all times. With limited movement options, you'll have to decide when's best to make your move. It will hear you.

Plan ahead. Unlock various shortcuts and hidden pathways in the school to assist you in navigating throughout. Be sure of your route in order to avoid any unwanted encounters.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Dive into a full, fleshed out psychological horror experience. Senior Sunset offers a linear story with gameplay that can vary between cautious, slow, and calculated & intense and fast-paced.

Beware of him. A constant, looming threat is ever-present throughout your descent into the school. It will do everything in its power to hunt you down. With its advanced detection & reactive capabilities, nowhere is safe for long.

The school is a dark, detailed location packed full of places to explore. Slowly unlock different rooms and halls as you journey through with little to no navigational assistance.

content_descriptors.notes: There are a few rooms containing blood on the walls, ceiling, etc. along with audio logs that insinuate graphic violence occurring, however that is never seen. Some body parts and dead bodies may be found, however they are not accompanied with any blood.

short_description: 35 dead students, dozens of silenced parents, and one police coverup later you decide it's time to take matters into your own hands. You descend into the depths of your high school to figure out what really happened to your classmates.
